connector.name: Facebook Publisher
connector.registryDescription: Safe Facebook Pages publishing with brand-voice, image-required & anti-duplication checks.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-fb-publisher. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the anthonyjbolo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: META_USER_TOKEN
env.description: Long-lived Meta Graph API user or page token. Required for publishing.

env.name: MCP_FB_PUBLISHER_CONFIG
env.description: Absolute path to your config.yaml (per-page brand voices, banned topics, image policy).

env.name: MCP_FB_PUBLISHER_CONFIG_JSON
env.description: Inline JSON config (alternative to file path, useful for serverless deploys).

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key for image generation via gpt-image-1 (optional).

env.name: FAL_KEY
env.description: fal.ai API key for image generation via Flux Pro (optional).
